note.zh: 在豆包办公（Doubao Work）智能体模式中以豆包 2.1 Pro 高思考档位一次生成；未调用技能、插件、MCP 或外部素材，SVG 一次写入且未返工修复。
note.en: One-shot SVG generated by Doubao 2.1 Pro at the high thinking effort in Doubao Work agent mode; no skills, plugins, MCP servers, or external assets were used, and the output was not reworked.

note.zh: 单文件原生 WebGL 体素世界，未使用外部素材。初次本地渲染验证时发现一个未定义循环变量、lookAt 矩阵行列布局错误以及矩阵乘法错误，已逐一修复并通过 Edge 渲染检查。
note.en: A single-file native WebGL voxel world with no external assets. Initial local rendering exposed an undefined loop variable, transposed lookAt matrix layout, and incorrect matrix multiplication; all were fixed and the result passed Edge rendering checks.

note.zh: 单文件 Three.js 镂空机械表，使用 CDN import map。本地验证时发现螺旋线误传点数组、摆轮部件参数错位以及 RoomEnvironment 兼容问题，已改为 BufferGeometry、修正参数并使用程序化环境贴图；早期版本通过 Edge 渲染，后续进一步改为镂空中环并提亮，因 CDN 网络间歇未重复最终截图。
note.en: A single-file Three.js skeleton watch using a CDN import map. Local validation found a spiral line receiving a raw point array, misordered balance-part arguments, and a RoomEnvironment compatibility issue; these were fixed with BufferGeometry, corrected arguments, and a procedural environment texture. An earlier build passed Edge rendering; the middle ring was later opened and lighting brightened, with no repeated final screenshot due intermittent CDN access.

note.zh: React、TypeScript 与 Three.js 的完整 Vite 项目，包含 Dust2 区域、人形角色、多武器、C4 回合、5v5 AI、HUD、小地图和程序化音效。构建时修复一个 PointLight 类型错误，npm install、production build 与 Edge 运行截图均通过。
note.en: A complete Vite project using React, TypeScript, and Three.js, including Dust2 areas, humanoid characters, multiple weapons, C4 rounds, 5v5 AI, HUD, minimap, and procedural audio. A PointLight typing error was fixed during build; npm install, production build, and an Edge runtime screenshot all passed.

note.zh: React、TypeScript 与 Three.js 的体素程序化3D电影项目，时长180秒，含中文字幕、结构化 voice cue 清单、时间轴、场景调度和程序化音效。构建时修复一个材质类型错误，production build 与开场、海底场景 Edge 截图均通过。
note.en: A voxel-style procedural 3D film project using React, TypeScript, and Three.js, with a 180-second duration, Chinese subtitles, a structured voice cue list, timeline, scene direction, and procedural audio. A material typing error was fixed; the production build and Edge screenshots of the opening and underwater scenes passed.
